traits.name: Swordmaster
traits.description: The swordmaster gains an advantage on Insight tests against any humanoid they've instructed before.

actions.name: Staggering Blow
actions.description: Attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) impact damage. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) impact damage, and the target gains a disadvantage on the next Discipline test they make before the end of the swordmaster's next turn.

actions.name: Disarm Opponent
actions.description: The swordmaster moves up to 10 feet then attempts to disarm an enemy within reach who is wielding a melee weapon. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Discipline test or drop their weapon and have it flung up to 15 feet away in any direction.

actions.name: Parry
actions.description: Before the swordmaster is hit by a melee attack, they increase their Physical defense by 3 against that attack, potentially causing it to miss. To do so, the swordmaster must sense the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

strikes.name: Sidesword
strikes.description: Attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) keen damage.
